'''Lorchlar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] within the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed in the Republic's secret [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. In the prison he operated a stall in the [[Prison Command Center]] of the [[Minimum Security Section]], where he sold weapon modification items from a stall to various Republic personnel. He wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with [[Color/Legends|orange]] coloring and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] while at his stall. Lorchlar had fair skin, black hair, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lorchlar first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in which he served as a Republic weapon mods vendor on Belsavis.
